address: via Castello di Montebello 6, località Montebello, Poggio Torriana, 47824, Italy
bio: At Montebello, near Poggio Torriana, in the hills of the Rimini hinterland, a small medieval village is home to the kitchen of a highly accomplished chef from the Romagna region, Gasperini. Contemporary regional cuisine, without excessive reinterpretation, that aims squarely at flavour and the satisfaction of the palate: an excellent experience!
